description: Reading package-lock.json is forbidden (huge, low-signal)
message: Reading package-lock.json is forbidden (huge, low-signal). Use rg/Grep for the specific dependency.

description: Reading env files is forbidden (may contain secrets)
message: Reading env files is forbidden (may contain secrets). Only .env.example/.sample/.template are allowed.

description: Reading *.pem, *.key or paths in project.json forbidden_reads is forbidden
message: Reading key/certificate files (*.pem, *.key) or paths listed in forbidden_reads is forbidden.

description: Reading >300 lines requires bounded read
message: File has >300 lines. To prevent context token waste, search with rg/Grep first or call Read with offset and limit (<=300 lines).

description: Mass cat of package-lock.json is forbidden
message: Do not cat package-lock.json (huge, low-signal). Use rg/Grep for the specific dependency.

description: Shell access to .env files is forbidden
message: Access to .env files is forbidden (may contain secrets). Only .env.example/.sample/.template are allowed.

description: Destructive or force push is forbidden
message: Force/destructive push is forbidden (--force/-f/--mirror/--delete/+ref). Pushing to main is exclusive to @PM.

description: git reset --hard is forbidden
message: git reset --hard is forbidden (destroys committed/uncommitted work).

description: git clean -f is forbidden
message: git clean -f is forbidden (deletes untracked files).

description: git checkout -- . is forbidden
message: git checkout -- . is forbidden (discards all working-tree changes).

description: git restore . is forbidden
message: git restore . is forbidden (discards all working-tree changes).

description: git branch -D is forbidden
message: git branch -D is forbidden (force-deletes a branch).

description: Recursive force delete (rm -rf) is forbidden
message: Recursive force delete (rm -rf / -r -f / -fr) is forbidden.

description: Piping download directly to shell is forbidden
message: Piping a downloaded script straight into a shell is forbidden.

description: sudo is forbidden in every runtime
message: sudo is forbidden (privilege escalation).

description: cat, or head/tail -n >300, of a file with >300 lines is forbidden
message: This would print >300 lines of a >300-line file. Search with rg -n first, then print a bounded range.

description: gh pr create requires a valid .harness/complete.json seal (harness-gate.sh --verify)
message: No valid gate seal. Run harness-kit/core/scripts/harness-gate.sh before gh pr create.

description: gh pr merge requires harness-merge-check.mjs: seal block == PR head, issue lesson in the PR, PPC + label for harness changes
message: Merge blocked: run node harness-kit/core/scripts/harness-merge-check.mjs <pr> and fix every reported item.

description: harness/, harness-kit/, .github/ and render/compose change only on an authorized <type>/<issue-#>-harness-<slug> branch
message: Protected harness source. Changes need an authorized harness branch created by the PM; lessons go to harness/experience/.

description: Writing to .git/hooks, .claude/, .agents/, .gemini/ or .opencode/ is forbidden
message: Writing to .git/hooks or .claude/ is forbidden (would tamper with the sandbox). Same for .agents/, .gemini/ and .opencode/.

description: Writing a generated artifact listed in harness/harness.lock is forbidden
message: Generated artifact: edit `harness/` or `harness-kit/` and run render (node harness-kit/core/scripts/harness-render.mjs).

description: Injects git config command on GitHub Push Protection GH007 error
message: GitHub Push Protection (GH007) violation detected. Configure your noreply email: git config --worktree user.email <email>

pattern: cd: .*: No such file or directory
description: Injects cwd remediation when a cd fails because the working directory changed
message: cwd persists between Bash calls; run `pwd` and use absolute paths.

description: Injects bounded-output remediation when a tool output exceeds 20,000 characters
message: Tool output exceeded 20,000 characters. Use bounded reads next time (`rg -n`, `offset` + `limit`, `head`/`tail`, `--stat`).

description: Warns (never blocks) when a write lands outside .harness/scope.json; no-op without scope.json
message: Warning: the written file is outside the declared scope in .harness/scope.json.
